_about: Index of style recipes (texture volume). Recipes are this skill's own designs; evidence_cards link to figure cards that show the style. Links chosen by looking at the crops (2026-11-13): depth-cv = cuboid/slab tensors or gradient fills; soft-pastel = rounded light-tint blocks with same-hue strokes; editorial-minimal = black/grey line work with at most one accent.

depth-cv.name: C · depth (CV)
depth-cv.description: Soft gradients and drop shadows, cuboid feature maps; reads as layered depth.

drawio-default.name: A · drawio default
drawio-default.description: Reference only: drawio's stock blue boxes, black lines, square corners.

editorial-minimal.name: D · editorial minimal
editorial-minimal.description: Grayscale plus one accent, thin lines, square corners, typographic hierarchy.

soft-pastel.name: B · soft pastel
soft-pastel.description: Rounded corners, light fills with same-hue strokes, gray arrows, warm container for the proposed module.

compact.name: compact (column width)
compact.description: soft-pastel with tight spacing and body-size small text: for single-column figures (mix spacing/typography into any style)
